from.place: the assertion that the category of sheaves of modules on a ringed site is abelian

title: Sheaves of modules on a small ringed site are abelian
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] whose underlying category is small (its objects and morphisms form sets), and let $\mathcal O$ be a sheaf of commutative rings on $\mathcal C$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Then the category $\Mod(\mathcal O)$ of sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] is abelian.
